Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often out for lunch. Weekends: Sleeps in. Errands midday (12:00-16:00). Home evenings. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in. Errands midday (12:00-16:00). Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
*Note: Thursday was an exception; Nora was home sick all day.*

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items:
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet, charger. Wardrobe has scarf.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book. Dresser has jacket.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Hat on hook. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dog bowl on floor.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Monday Update):
At 00:00, both home. Kitchen items (mugs, glasses, plates, bowls) moved from tables to sink/cupboards/dish rack. Phones returned to nightstands.
At 08:00, Yuki and Nora home. Dog food bag moved to pantry. Nora’s shoes moved to rack. Yuki’s phone left house (likely lunch/errand).
At 12:00, Yuki home. Nora left for work. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE: backpack, jacket, keys, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, water bottle. Yuki’s mug, tablet, water bottle moved to desk.
At 16:00, Yuki home. Nora at work.
At 20:00, Yuki and Nora home. Nora’s work items returned to entry spots. Yuki’s phone returned to nightstand. Kitchen items (knife, pan, pot, spatula, cutting board) moved to counter. Dog bowl moved to pantry.

Current Status (Mon 23:59):
- Yuki: Home. Items in usual spots.
- Nora: Home. Items in usual spots.
- Dog: Home.

Notes:
- Yuki’s routine: Takes phone when leaving for lunch/work. Returns in evening. On weekends, takes personal items (gym bag, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, wallet, water bottle) out for midday errands.
- Nora’s routine: Takes work items (laptop, backpack, lunchbox, etc.) to office on weekdays. On weekends, takes personal items (backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet) out for midday errands.
- Dog leash: Shared. Taken out by Yuki on Wed, Nora on Thu (08:00).
- Phone: Yuki’s phone was missing 08:00-12:00 on Sunday. Likely taken by Yuki for lunch/errand.
